document.title: Form PENS.B/1 — Expression of Interest to Validate Non-Contributory Service

chunks.part: Form PENS.B/1 — Expression of Interest to Validate Non-Contributory Service
chunks.heading: What form PENS.B/1 is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.B/1 is used to express an interest in validating non-contributory service under article 23 of the UNJSPF Regulations. It is time-sensitive: failure to submit within one year of entry or re-entry into the Fund results in forfeiture of the right to validate.

chunks.part: Form PENS.B/1 — Expression of Interest to Validate Non-Contributory Service
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.B/1
chunks.text: The form has three sections: Section 1 - Participant information (UID, pension number, date of birth, name, current employing organization, duty station, phone, work email); Section 2 - Prior period(s) of non-contributory service (organization, start date, end date - up to four periods); Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.part: Form PENS.B/1 — Expression of Interest to Validate Non-Contributory Service
chunks.heading: Acknowledgements made when signing form PENS.B/1
chunks.text: By signing, the participant confirms interest in validating the specified non-contributory service, confirms having read article 23 of the UNJSPF Regulations, section E of the Administrative Rules, and the form's instructions, and requests an estimate of the contributions due. The participant also acknowledges that validation will not proceed until a final election to validate is submitted, and that once elected, payment to the employing organization is due within 90 days of notification of the amount.

chunks.part: Form PENS.B/1 — Expression of Interest to Validate Non-Contributory Service
chunks.heading: New entrant/re-entrant note on form PENS.B/1
chunks.text: The form notes that new entrants or re-entrants may also restore prior contributory service under article 24 if they apply within one year of entry/re-entry (and before separation if earlier), and may use any applicable transfer agreement under article 13.
